reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes OneCoin as a global financial platform, makes strong safety and audit assurances, claims users can save over 80%, and directs viewers to a OneLife signup link. It encourages participation by presenting mining and joining OneCoin as an accessible financial revolution rather than warning about or critically examining the offer.

citations.quote: Millions of people around the world are mining OneCoin today.
mining the coin transferring money and making payments with Onetcoin is absolutely safe.
to deposit money and to save over 80%.
ONE world, ONE COIN join the financial revolution
OneCoin cryptocurrency is changing the world: https://www.onelife.eu/signup/djammy33.

opening.argument: The presentation emphasizes safeguards and compliance rather than hiding risk. It explains that KYC procedures are intended to prevent money laundering, identity theft, fraud, and terrorist financing, and it describes a monthly blockchain audit. Those are concrete oversight assurances that invite evaluation of how the service operates. The material also frames the wallet as managed centrally, with technical aspects handled for users, rather than asking viewers to rely on an anonymous or unexplained process. On this record, the claims can be read as a favorable presentation of a financial technology whose controls are being highlighted, not as proof that viewers were deceptively solicited.

citations.quote: to prevent money laundering, identity theft, financial fraud, and terrorist financing, OneCoin has implemented KYC procedures, thus preventing any possible misconduct by its clients.
OneCoin also became the first cryptocurrency with a monthly audit of its blockchain!
Because of our centralized model we take care of all technical aspects, ensuring that your mined coins are safe.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The signup link and promotional language show an invitation, but they do not establish that the invitation was deceptive. The savings statement is a benefit claim, not evidence of a guaranteed return from mining. The prosecution also treats safety language as inherently fraudulent, even though the presentation identifies specific KYC and audit controls that provide a non-scam interpretation.

citations.quote: OneCoin cryptocurrency is changing the world: https://www.onelife.eu/signup/djammy33.
to deposit money and to save over 80%.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Compliance language does not validate the underlying financial opportunity. The presentation still says mining and payments are “absolutely safe,” claims savings over 80%, and directs viewers to sign up. A claimed audit and KYC process show only what the promoter asserts; they do not establish that users actually received the promised benefits or that the claims were independently verified.

citations.quote: mining the coin transferring money and making payments with Onetcoin is absolutely safe.
to deposit money and to save over 80%.
OneCoin cryptocurrency is changing the world: https://www.onelife.eu/signup/djammy33.

opening.argument: The content can reasonably be understood as an explanatory presentation about how a cryptocurrency service is intended to work. It begins by asking what OneCoin is, then describes transfers, payments, wallet creation, KYC, and blockchain auditing. The title itself identifies the material as a presentation, and the visual sequence depicts generic transfer, wallet, payment, and educational imagery rather than a documented customer transaction or a personal earnings testimonial. That instructional structure supports classifying it as technology and operational explanation, even if the presentation uses favorable language.

citations.quote: New Onecoin presentation 2017
What is OneCoin ? Millions of people around the world are mining OneCoin today.
When joining OneCoin we automatically create an e-wallet for you.
OneCoin also became the first cryptocurrency with a monthly audit of its blockchain!

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling it a presentation does not make it a tutorial, but the narration does explain the proposed functions and safeguards in sequence. The visuals show illustrative operations, not a verified payment result or a personal income claim. “Join the financial revolution” is promotional rhetoric, yet it does not by itself determine whether the primary content is an instructional explanation of a technology.

citations.quote: New Onecoin presentation 2017
When joining OneCoin we automatically create an e-wallet for you.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The explanatory format is used to promote participation, not to neutrally teach cryptocurrency. The narration says people join to mine, transfer, make payments, and save over 80%, while the closing message explicitly urges viewers to join. The wallet and payment illustrations reinforce the proposed use case, but they do not establish a genuine educational purpose or successful operation.

citations.quote: People join OneCoin for a reason… To learn about cryptocurrency. To mine the coin. To transfer money, to make payments without the need for expensive or unsafe intermediaries, to deposit money and to save over 80%.
ONE world, ONE COIN join the financial revolution

opening.argument: At most, the material promotes an ordinary financial service and referral destination. It describes proposed uses such as transfers, payments, wallets, and savings, and supplies a signup URL. Crucially, the supplied content does not state a required purchase, a mining-package price, a downline commission, or a specific guaranteed payout. The frames show generic illustrations of a wallet, transfer, payment, and global connectivity, not a displayed payment demand or documented return. Without those mechanism details, the evidence supports service promotion but does not establish a scam mechanism.

citations.quote: it gives instant access to easier, faster and low-cost financial services
You do not need to go to your traditional financial institution or escrow agent to send money to your loved ones.

rebuttal.rebuttal: A signup URL makes the material promotional, but promotion is not itself proof of fraud. The prosecution identifies broad benefits and persuasive framing, yet does not point to a required deposit, package purchase, downline structure, or stated payout. “Mining” is mentioned, but the supplied material does not specify a paid mining arrangement or quantify a mining return.

citations.quote: OneCoin cryptocurrency is changing the world: https://www.onelife.eu/signup/djammy33.
Millions of people around the world are mining OneCoin today.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The absence of a quoted package price does not remove the central inducement: viewers are told that people mine OneCoin, can save over 80%, and should join the financial revolution. The video presents mining participation together with financial benefits and a signup destination. Those combined claims can function as solicitation even without spelling out the payment step in the supplied excerpt.
